code = r'''
import numpy as np, json
from poolfit import *
def labels_for(ids, practice, LABELS):
    P={r['id']:r for r in practice()}
    return np.array([LABELS.index(P[i]['label']) if isinstance(P[i]['label'],str) else P[i]['label'] for i in ids])
def folds(y, k, seed):
    rng=np.random.RandomState(seed); f=np.zeros(len(y),int)
    for c in np.unique(y):
        idx=np.where(y==c)[0]; rng.shuffle(idx); f[idx]=np.arange(len(idx))%k
    return f
def lin_feats(M0, tr):
    X=M0[:,KEEP]; mu=X[tr].mean(0); C=X-mu; s=np.sqrt((C[tr]**2).sum(1).mean()); return C/s
def cv(M9, C9, M0, y, c=10.0, na=1008, lam=0.02, c0=0.5, k=10, seed=0, use_lin=True, Zgiven=None):
    f=folds(y,k,seed); Y=np.eye(8)[y]; pred=np.zeros(len(y),int)
    for i in range(k):
        tr=f!=i; te=~tr
        mu9=M9[tr].mean(0)
        Z=pool_z(M9,C9,c,mu9) if Zgiven is None else Zgiven
        Zt=Z[tr]; Wfull=anchor_dirs(Zt)
        Kt=gelu(Wfull@Wfull.T*768) if False else None
        # pivoted cholesky on gelu(cos) kernel among train
        Kc=gelu((Zt@Wfull.T))  # cos(z_i, anchor_j) approx
        Kc=0.5*(Kc+Kc.T)
        piv=pivchol(Kc, na)
        Wd=Wfull[piv]; Kaa=Kc[np.ix_(piv,piv)]
        Phi=feats(Z,Wd)
        Lin=lin_feats(M0,tr) if use_lin else np.zeros((len(y),0))
        coef,b=fit(Phi[tr],Lin[tr],Y[tr],Kaa,lam,c0)
        S=np.concatenate([Phi[te],Lin[te]],1)@coef+b
        pred[te]=S.argmax(1)
    return (pred==y).mean()
'''
open('lib7.py','w').write(code)
